phase: L1 audit P1 #4 large-transfer scan fail-open (from origin/main 1cfd86a)
purpose: Fix L1 audit P1 #4: the large-transfer scan swallowed RpcError per lookup, so a total RPC failure returned an empty list that read as no large transfers.
plan: Count failed lookups. When lookups failed and no transaction was read, raise DataStale. When only some failed, return coverage=partial. Otherwise coverage=complete. A successful scan returns its transfers unchanged.
rollback_plan: Revert the commit on bot-05-rug/l1-p1-onchain. Expected recovery time: about 10 minutes (estimate, not measured). The output gains one coverage field; consumers that ignore unknown keys are unaffected.

claims.claim: A total signature-lookup failure raises DataStale. It never returns an empty list.
When every transaction read fails after signatures succeed, DataStale is raised instead of an empty partial.
A partial wallet or transaction failure with readable transfers returns coverage=partial.
A fully successful scan returns its transfers unchanged, with coverage=complete. An empty successful scan is complete, not stale.
